title: brops.agent-bundle.v1 — a produced agent's manifest
description: The manifest is the only file the loader reads first, and its bytes ARE the bundle digest: sha256(manifest.json) must equal the directory name. Approval state deliberately appears nowhere here, because approving must not change these bytes. No secret, no locator, no host and no URL appears anywhere in a bundle. Implemented by apps/desktop/src-tauri/core/src/agent_bundle.rs.

bundle_id.description: The AGENT's identity, stable across versions. Two versions of one agent share this and differ in bundle_version and digest.

flow_ref.description: Bundle-relative path to the flow. Required even when trivial.

grant_ref.description: Bundle-relative path to the grant. REQUIRED even when the grant is empty: 'this agent needs nothing' is a statement someone made, and 'there is no file' is not.

files.description: TOTAL over the bundle: every regular file except manifest.json appears exactly once. A file on disk with no entry is a refusal and an entry with no file is a refusal — a partial file table is how an unreviewed prompt rides into an approved bundle.
